x1.description: scalar or array. Specifies the bases.
constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes

x2.description: scalar or array. Specifies the exponent. ``x1`` and ``x2`` should either have same shape or be broadcast compatible.
constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes

output.description: An array containing the base ``x1`` exponentials of ``x2`` with same dtype as input.

constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes
